name: Art-direct a featured image that carries the article's claim, not its topic
query: برای مقاله‌ای که استدلال می‌کند کش وردپرس برای کاربران لاگین‌شده بی‌فایده است، یک تصویر شاخص خلاقانه بساز. تیتر فارسی هم باید روی تصویر باشد.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Do not generate immediately; extract the visual claim as one sentence
Step 2: Propose three concepts from three different families per references/concept-engine.md, each with its risk
Step 3: Refuse to put Persian text into the generation prompt and explain why, offering the HTML/CSS overlay route
Step 4: Build the prompt with all six slots filled plus a negative clause and an aspect ratio
Step 5: Run scripts/build_prompt.mjs and resolve every cliché and filler token
Step 6: Judge the generated image against references/visual-qa.md before showing it
Step 7: Produce the 16:9, 1200x630, in-article, and thumbnail crops with byte budgets
Step 8: Write a Latin filename and descriptive Persian alt text under 125 characters
success_criteria: build_prompt.mjs reports no cliché subjects and no missing slots
Persian text is composed as a real overlay layer, never sent to the image model
Three concepts come from three different families, not three variations of one
Prompt names a specific light source and direction, not 'cinematic lighting'
No handshake, glowing brain, circuit board, or other banned cliché appears
A separate 1200x630 OG crop exists rather than a crop of the 16:9
Filename is Latin and descriptive; alt text describes the image, not keywords
Each shipped file is WebP/AVIF and within the byte budget
The image is still identifiable at 150 px wide
